videos.title: U.S. Cuts Tariffs on Steel Derivatives and More, Worth $2.3 Billion (06/03/2026/12MBC News)
videos.subtitle_summary:
The user wants me to summarize a YouTube video caption in Korean, around 500 characters, using only Korean (no English), and summarize the key content in 3-5 sentences.
Key points from the caption:
1. US government is cutting tariffs on steel, aluminum, and copper derivative products worth about $2.3 billion
2. Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy announced that the US government issued an executive order to reduce tariffs on some metal derivative products
3. From the 8th until year-end, tariffs will be reduced on items like excavators, bulldozers, tractors, and other mobile industrial machinery
4. Target countries are those that have tariff agreements with the US, including Korea, Japan, UK, and EU member states
5. US also relaxed the policy requiring 95% US-made steel to apply 10% low tariff, now allowing 85% US-made steel
